$comment: Engine-owned L2 adapter for product code (dev lanes). Language-neutral: the project's own lint, type-check and test commands (wiring.verifyScript) are the standard and run at pre-push and in CI; these rules add what those tools cannot be trusted to enforce. Shipped by lf-qa-harness-os, so it is identical in every consumer.

rules.never: a password, token, key or private key literal in source or tests
rules.instead: read it from the environment or the secret store; tests use generated or fixture credentials
rules.why: A committed credential is a breach, not a style issue.
rules.message: Hardcoded secret. Read it from the environment or the secret store.

rules.instead: run one test from the command line (the runner's grep/-k/--filter) and commit the whole suite
rules.why: A focused test silently skips every other test in CI.
rules.message: Focused test. Remove .only / fit / fdescribe so the whole suite runs.

rules.never: a skipped or disabled test with no ticket or reason
rules.instead: fix the test, or quarantine it with the ticket on the same line (it.skip('... ABC-123', ...), @pytest.mark.skip(reason="ABC-123: ..."), @Disabled("ABC-123: ..."))
rules.why: An unrecorded skip hides risk with no owner and no end date.
rules.message: Skipped test with no recorded quarantine. Name the ticket on the same line, or give the reason the framework records.

rules.never: eslint-disable without `-- reason`, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, bare # noqa, bare # type: ignore, bare //nolint
rules.instead: fix the finding; if it is a false positive, suppress the one rule with its reason (eslint-disable-next-line rule -- reason, @ts-expect-error -- reason, # noqa: E501, # type: ignore[attr-defined])
rules.why: A suppression without a reason hides a real defect from every later reader and reviewer.
rules.message: Suppression without a reason. Fix the finding, or state why on the same line.

rules.instead: remove it; use the IDE's breakpoints or a test that reproduces the case
rules.why: A leftover breakpoint hangs CI or a production process and was never meant to ship.
rules.message: Leftover breakpoint. Remove it before committing.

rules.never: TODO, FIXME, XXX or HACK with no ticket key
rules.instead: name the ticket on the line (TODO(ABC-123): ...), or do the work now
rules.why: A TODO with no ticket has no owner, so it is never done and never removed.
rules.message: TODO/FIXME without a ticket. Name the ticket or do it now.

agents.name: dev-builder
agents.description: Turns an approved plan into a change: failing tests first, then the smallest implementation that turns them green, then refactor with the tests green.
agents.when: Implement an approved plan behavior by behavior (red → green → refactor)

agents.name: dev-debugger
agents.description: Reproduce a failure, trace it to its root cause from evidence, and propose the exact fix with the test that proves it.
agents.when: A reproducible failure in source or its tests

agents.name: pre-merge-dev-gate
agents.description: Review the supplied diff and command evidence against the approved scope, design and plan, and return PASS, PASS_WITH_ACTIONS, or BLOCK.
agents.when: Review a change before merge — PASS / PASS_WITH_ACTIONS / BLOCK
agents.readOnlyRationale: Read/search only by design: the reviewer cannot edit or run anything, so the author never grades their own change.
